prose: The ex-Meta engineer follows up on his claim that Anthropic's Scion copies Mononoke. He now says it was a ripoff, and that his first post was deliberately charitable, assuming the similarity was mostly unintentional and the missing credit an oversight.
He answers the questions and objections the first post drew.
highlights: Author hardens his stance: 'this was a ripoff'.
Replies to reader objections about the first post.
